from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashPosition(BaseModel):
    """One company's cash and cash equivalents position from a 10-Q filing."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported in the filing")
    cash_and_equivalents: float | None = Field(description="The cash and cash equivalents amount as reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="How the amount is expressed: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The period end date for this cash figure")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency of the amount, typically USD")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_cash_positions: list[CompanyCashPosition]
